en-US.name: PinBoard TV
en-US.summary: Voice companion for your living room PinBoard TV ambient family hub.
en-US.description: Add groceries, pin chores, and leave sticky notes on your Fire TV pinboard using your voice with Alexa.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Pin Board to add oat milk to the grocery list
Alexa, tell Pin Board to remind Alex to walk the dog
Alexa, ask Pin Board what is on my grocery list

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open Fire TV PinBoardTV app to get the 6-digit code. Say 'Alexa, tell Pin Board my code is 123456' to pair.
